proposal.name: watcher crash recovery

statements.name: Spec
statements.says: The factory starts with an issue that has no commands, posts, branch or pull request, and every step is a Next step.

statements.name: NoDoubleAnswer
statements.says: No command, retry, build or merge is ever answered by more than one factory post.

statements.name: OnlyHolderActs
statements.says: No watcher ever takes an effect on GitHub while it doesn't hold the repository's lease.

statements.name: NoRunTwice
statements.says: No agent run is ever started twice for one draft or build.

statements.name: OnePullRequest
statements.says: Each build opens at most one pull request, even once that pull request is closed or merged.

statements.name: OneOpenPullRequest
statements.says: At most one of the ratified proposal's pull requests is open at a time: a retry's build opens its own only after the draft it replaces is closed.

statements.name: RetiredOnlyByRecord
statements.says: The factory closes a draft only once a record every watcher can read says a retry replaces it.

statements.name: NoReplacingMerged
statements.says: A retry whose draft someone merged starts no build and opens no pull request.

statements.name: OwnGate
statements.says: CI's gate counts only on the latest build's own pull request: it never stands passed before that pull request opens.

statements.name: OwnRun
statements.says: The latest build's result comes only from its own agent run, never from an earlier build's.

statements.name: OneMerge
statements.says: The pull request is merged at most once.

statements.name: MergeOnlyAfterGate
statements.says: The factory merges only after CI's gate passes on a pull request GitHub can merge.

statements.name: ReadiedOnlyWhenWatched
statements.says: The factory marks a failed draft ready only once it has answered a writer's retry that watches it again.

statements.name: ReadiedOnlyAfterGate
statements.says: The factory marks a draft ready only once CI's gate has passed on it and the factory can merge it: GitHub can merge it, and it doesn't change the trusted base.

statements.name: FollowSnapshotsKept
statements.says: Every accepted Workflow snapshot is durably retained with its original contents across effects, watchers and crashes.

statements.name: FollowOnePR
statements.says: A follow-up opens at most one PR for its source ratified-plan obligation and keeps the same branch and PR across attempts, closure and resumption.

statements.name: FollowOperationOnce
statements.says: Every recorded follow-up draft, creation, repair, publication, reopening and merge operation is dispatched at most once, including after a stopped operation or lost response.

statements.name: FollowOneMerge
statements.says: The follow-up PR is merged at most once across factory actions, external merges and recovery.

statements.name: FollowWriterRequired
statements.says: Closed or exhausted follow-up work resumes only after consuming an explicit writer request, and reopening uses the same PR under that authorization.

statements.name: FollowRenewalWaits
statements.says: A retry or resume received during an unresolved repair waits until that operation and its publication have been reconciled before the request is consumed.

statements.name: FollowSnapshotsBeforeEffects
statements.says: Every follow-up effect is tied to its own recorded intent and an already durable accepted Workflow snapshot bearing the stable source, branch and PR identity.

statements.name: FollowEffectLedger
statements.says: Pending and completed follow-up effects retain distinct operation identities, and an operation settles only after all its recorded effects are reconciled.

statements.name: FollowResultsCurrent
statements.says: An accepted follow-up result belongs to the current operation and a successful result belongs to the revision it acts on.

statements.name: FollowCurrentRevision
statements.says: Follow-up publication and merge effects use the current lease fence and head revision, and a merge uses CI and mergeability observations for that same revision.

statements.name: FollowAllowance
statements.says: Each Workflow-authorized repair consumes exactly one of the two allowances for its renewal period, and consuming a writer request once renews the allowance to two.

statements.name: FollowFailurePreserved
statements.says: Recovery preserves the actual failed, stopped or no-change result of a repair instead of changing its failure cause or refunding its recorded usage.

statements.name: FollowMergeConfirmed
statements.says: Merge authorization alone cannot establish a merge, while confirmed results and external observations settle through outcome handling without dispatching another merge for an externally merged PR.

statements.name: FollowAnswersOnce
statements.says: A follow-up writer retry or resume receives at most one answer across watchers and crashes.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: Every part of the state always has the expected kind of value.

statements.name: Merged
statements.says: The pull request can be merged and the merge reported.

statements.name: ReportedUnmergeable
statements.says: A pull request whose gate passed can be reported as one that can't merge.

statements.name: StoppedRunReported
statements.says: A build whose agent run stopped partway can be reported as stopped.

statements.name: RetryBuilt
statements.says: A writer's retry of a stopped build can open the pull request and be answered.

statements.name: RecoveredAfterCrashes
statements.says: After the most crashes allowed, the factory can still get the pull request merged and reported.

statements.name: Replaced
statements.says: A writer's retry can replace a failed draft: the factory closes the draft, and the retry's build opens a new pull request and is answered.

statements.name: ReplacedAndMerged
statements.says: The pull request that replaced a failed draft can be merged and the merge reported.

statements.name: FailedAgain
statements.says: A retry's build can leave a failed draft too, which a writer can retry in turn.

statements.name: StoppedAfterRetiring
statements.says: A retry's build can stop after the draft it replaces was closed, and be reported as stopped, keeping the record the next retry builds on.

statements.name: MergedDraftKept
statements.says: A retry whose draft someone merged is answered without replacing it.

statements.name: ClosedDraftNoted
statements.says: A retry whose draft someone else closed before its record was stored is answered without a build.

statements.name: WatchedBeforeGate
statements.says: A writer's retry can watch a failed draft again before CI's gate passes on it, and is answered while the factory waits for the gate.

statements.name: WatchedAndMerged
statements.says: A writer's retry can watch a failed draft again, and the factory marks it ready and merges it once CI's gate passes.

statements.name: WatchedButUnmergeable
statements.says: A watched draft the factory can't merge, such as one that changes the trusted base, is reported without being marked ready.

statements.name: CommandsAnswered
statements.says: Every command and retry a writer gives is eventually answered by a factory post.

statements.name: BuildsAnswered
statements.says: Every build a ratification or a retry starts is eventually answered: by its pull request, or by a report that it stopped.

statements.name: GatedPullRequestsSettled
statements.says: Once CI's gate passes on a pull request that isn't a failed draft, the factory eventually merges it or reports it: as one that can't merge, or as merged or closed by someone else.

statements.name: WatchedDraftsSettled
statements.says: Once CI's gate passes on a failed draft a writer's retry watches again, the factory eventually merges it or reports it: as one that can't merge, or as merged or closed by someone else.

statements.name: FairAcquire
statements.says: A running watcher eventually takes a lease that nobody holds.

statements.name: FairExpire
statements.says: A lease whose holder has crashed eventually runs out.

statements.name: FairAct
statements.says: A watcher holding the lease eventually takes the next effect that's due.

statements.name: FairFinishRun
statements.says: An agent run held by the lease's holder eventually finishes and is recorded.

statements.name: FairDropRun
statements.says: A watcher that has lost the lease eventually drops the agent run it was in.

statements.name: PostWithoutLooking
statements.says: A watcher posts its answer without looking for an answer already there.

statements.name: PostWithoutLease
statements.says: A watcher that woke after its lease ran out posts without checking the lease.

statements.name: RerunStoppedRun
statements.says: A watcher that finds an agent run that stopped partway starts it again.

statements.name: OpenWithoutLookingClosed
statements.says: A watcher finds no open pull request for the latest build, misses the one it opened that was since closed or merged, and opens another.

statements.name: OpenBeforeRetiring
statements.says: A retry's build opens its pull request while the draft it replaces is still open.

statements.name: RetireWithoutRecord
statements.says: The factory closes the draft before storing the retry's record, so after a crash its own close looks like someone else's.

statements.name: ReplaceMergedDraft
statements.says: A retry whose draft someone merged builds again anyway.

statements.name: KeepGateAcrossRetry
statements.says: A writer's retry keeps CI's result from the draft it replaces.

statements.name: FinishStaleRun
statements.says: A watcher whose agent run a retry made stale records it as the latest build's.

statements.name: CloseWithoutLease
statements.says: A watcher that woke after its lease ran out closes the draft without checking the lease.

statements.name: MarkReadyWithoutWatch
statements.says: The factory marks a failed draft ready when no writer's retry watches it again.

statements.name: MarkReadyBeforeGate
statements.says: The factory marks a watched draft ready before CI's gate passes on it.

statements.name: MarkUnmergeableReady
statements.says: The factory marks ready a watched draft it can't merge, such as one that changes the trusted base.

statements.name: AnswerWatchWithoutLooking
statements.says: A watcher answers a retry that watches a failed draft again without looking for an answer already there.

statements.name: AutomaticDraftAndCreateRecovery
statements.says: Failed follow-up drafting and creation can each recover automatically through fresh recorded attempts and open the single PR.

statements.name: RepairAfterCIFailure
statements.says: A CI failure can lead to a charged repair that publishes a new revision on the same PR.

statements.name: ExhaustedThenRenewed
statements.says: After two repairs are exhausted, a writer request can renew the allowance and permit another repair on the same PR.

statements.name: ClosedFollowupResumed
statements.says: A writer request can resume closed follow-up work by reopening its existing PR.

statements.name: LostCreationAdoptsClosed
statements.says: A lost creation response can adopt the existing PR after a person closes it.

statements.name: LostCreationAdoptsMerged
statements.says: A lost creation response can adopt and settle the existing PR after a person merges it.

statements.name: LostRepairPublicationRecovered
statements.says: A lost repair publication response can be reconciled without publishing or charging the repair again.

statements.name: LostMergeResponseRecovered
statements.says: After a crash, a lost merge response can be reconciled as success from the actual remote result.

statements.name: UnknownMergeRecorded
statements.says: Recovery can record an unknown merge outcome while leaving the work unsettled.

statements.name: MergeRefusalReconciled
statements.says: Recovery can reconcile and report a definitive merge refusal without claiming a merge.

statements.name: ExternalMergeObserved
statements.says: An externally merged follow-up can settle from observation with no fabricated CI result or factory merge dispatch.

statements.name: PendingRenewalReconciled
statements.says: A request arriving during a repair can be answered once after reconciliation and renew the allowance to two.

statements.name: FailedAndNoChangeRepairsRetained
statements.says: Failed and no-change repairs can retain their different causes and both consume their authorized attempts.

statements.name: InvalidatedRepairRetainsUsage
statements.says: A repair invalidated by a newer head can settle without publishing stale contents or refunding its attempt.

statements.name: TwoWatchersRecoverFollowup
statements.says: Two watchers can both take part in a follow-up that is merged and settled after the maximum modeled crashes.

statements.name: FollowRunsSettled
statements.says: Every started follow-up agent operation eventually has a durable reconciled outcome under watcher fairness.

statements.name: FollowPublicationsSettled
statements.says: Every dispatched follow-up publication eventually reconciles its durable result without waiting for a person.

statements.name: FollowKnownMergesSettled
statements.says: A confirmed remote merge or definitive merge refusal is eventually settled through the follow-up outcome path.

statements.name: FollowRequestsAnswered
statements.says: Every modeled explicit writer retry or resume is eventually consumed and answered after any unresolved repair is reconciled.

statements.name: FollowAuthorizedWorkStarts
statements.says: Every accepted follow-up operation authorization eventually dispatches its recorded effect or reconciles a superseding remote observation under watcher fairness.

statements.name: DuplicateFollowCreation
statements.says: Recovery misses a closed or merged PR after losing its creation response and creates another.

statements.name: DuplicateFollowRun
statements.says: Recovery restarts the same stopped follow-up operation instead of recording a fresh attempt.

statements.name: DuplicateFollowMerge
statements.says: Recovery performs a second merge after the follow-up PR was already merged.

statements.name: ApplyStaleRepairResult
statements.says: A watcher applies an older operation result to the current repair.

statements.name: DispatchWithoutRecord
statements.says: Recovery starts a follow-up agent effect before recording its intent and snapshot association.

statements.name: FollowEffectAfterLeaseLoss
statements.says: A watcher continues a follow-up effect after losing the repository lease.

statements.name: ReuseFollowCI
statements.says: Recovery reuses CI and mergeability from an older revision after a repair changes the head.

statements.name: ResumeWithoutWriter
statements.says: Recovery renews a closed or exhausted follow-up without an explicit writer request.

statements.name: RenewBeforeReconciliation
statements.says: Recovery consumes a pending writer request before the existing repair and publication are reconciled.

statements.name: TreatAuthorizationAsMerge
statements.says: Recovery treats a persisted merge authorization as proof that GitHub merged the PR.

statements.name: ChargeLostPushAgain
statements.says: Recovery spends a second repair allowance while reconciling a lost publication response.

statements.name: HideRepairFailure
statements.says: Recovery changes a no-change repair result into a generic failure.

statements.name: FollowAutomaticRetries
statements.says: A reconciled failed or stopped draft or failed creation eventually starts a fresh recorded operation automatically under Workflow authorization.

proposal.module_text:
---- MODULE WatcherRecovery ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets, Sequences

CONSTANTS Watchers, MaxCrashes, FollowCases, MaxFollowOps, FollowCrashLimit

VARIABLES lane, fence, follow,
    given,       \* commands a writer has given on the issue
    posts,       \* number of factory posts answering each command or event
    retried,     \* a writer has given a retry, so the latest build is a retry's
    retryPosts,  \* factory posts answering the latest retry
    buildPosts,  \* factory posts answering the latest build: a pull request, or a stopped run
    runs,        \* each agent run as recorded: "none", "recorded" or "done"
    runStarts,   \* how many times each agent run was started (history)
    ratPushed,   \* the issue's branch holds the ratification
    codePushed,  \* the latest build's code is pushed
    prs,         \* pull requests opened for the latest build (history)
    pr,          \* the latest build's pull request: "none", "draft", "ready", "closed" or "merged"
    gate,        \* CI's gate on that pull request's head: "none" or "pass"
    mergeable,   \* whether GitHub can merge it
    merges,      \* number of merges made
    pred,        \* the draft the latest retry replaces: "none", "draft", "retired", "closed" or "merged"
    intent,      \* the latest retry's record that it replaces that draft is stored
    watched,     \* a writer's retry watches the latest build's failed draft again
    watchPosts,  \* factory posts answering that retry
    marked,      \* the factory marked the latest build's draft ready (history)
    lease,       \* the watcher holding the repository's lease, or "nobody"
    up,          \* whether each watcher is running
    inRun,       \* the agent run each watcher is in the middle of, or "none"
    crashes,     \* crashes and stalls so far
    unleased     \* watchers that ever took an effect without holding the lease (history)

vars == <<given, posts, retried, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed,
          codePushed, prs, pr, gate, mergeable, merges, pred, intent, watched, watchPosts,
          marked, lease, up, inRun, crashes, unleased, lane, fence, follow>>

\* Commands a writer gives once: solve (a draft), ratify and a note. A retry
\* is apart: a writer can give one after each build that stopped or failed,
\* to build again, or to watch the build's failed draft again.
Cmds == {"solve", "ratify", "note"}

\* Everything else the factory answers with one post: the commands, and the merge.
Keys == Cmds \cup {"merge"}

\* Steps that start an agent run: the draft, and the latest build. A retry's
\* build is a new run, which leaves a watcher still in the one before stale.
RunKeys == {"solve", "build"}

NoOne == "nobody"

\* A bounded second lane exercises the follow-up protocol without taking the
\* Cartesian product with the unchanged ordinary-command model. A case fixes
\* external outcomes, not the ordering of watchers or reconciliation. Each
\* case permits FollowCrashLimit arbitrary crashes at every boundary; the
\* lost-push case additionally permits a second crash before publication
\* reconciliation, up to MaxCrashes. Ordinary recovery keeps its original bound.
\* applied and checks are ghost conjunctions over accepted results and dispatch
\* preconditions, avoiding storage of irrelevant watcher-history permutations.
FOps == 1..MaxFollowOps
FEffectKinds == {"run", "publication", "merge", "reopen", "answer"}
FEffects == (0..MaxFollowOps) \X FEffectKinds
FKinds == {"none", "draft", "create", "repair", "merge", "reopen"}
FOutcomes == {"none", "success", "failed", "nochange", "stopped", "invalidated", "unknown", "refused"}
FIdentity == [source |-> "ratified-plan-obligation", branch |-> "followup-branch", pr |-> "followup-pr"]
FEmptyLocal == [op |-> 0, fence |-> 0]

FSnapshot(op, kind, head, left, round, cause, stage) ==
    [identity |-> FIdentity, op |-> op, kind |-> kind, head |-> head,
     left |-> left, round |-> round, cause |-> cause, stage |-> stage]

FollowInitial(c) ==
    [scenario |-> c, phase |-> "idle", next |-> "draft", op |-> 0,
     kinds |-> [o \in FOps |-> "none"], bases |-> [o \in FOps |-> 0],
     rounds |-> [o \in FOps |-> 0], starts |-> [o \in FOps |-> 0],
     raw |-> [o \in FOps |-> "none"], results |-> [o \in FOps |-> "none"],
     resultSnapshots |-> [o \in FOps |-> 0],
     snapshots |-> <<>>, accepted |-> <<>>, intents |-> [e \in FEffects |-> 0],
     pending |-> {}, completed |-> {}, cancelled |-> {}, dispatches |-> [e \in FEffects |-> 0],
     charged |-> {}, left |-> 2, round |-> 0, holds |-> {},
     requested |-> FALSE, consumed |-> 0, barrier |-> 0, answers |-> 0,
     owner |-> NoOne, runFence |-> 0, locals |-> [w \in Watchers |-> FEmptyLocal],
     applied |-> TRUE, checks |-> TRUE, actors |-> {}, rejected |-> FALSE,
     publicationRefused |-> {}, externalDispatches |-> [o \in FOps |-> 0], remotePR |-> "none", knownPR |-> "none", creations |-> 0, reopens |-> 0,
     remoteHead |-> 0, head |-> 0, publications |-> [o \in FOps |-> 0],
     remoteCI |-> "none", remoteCIHead |-> 0, remoteCanMerge |-> FALSE, remoteMergeHead |-> 0, ci |-> "none", ciHead |-> 0,
     canMerge |-> FALSE, mergeHead |-> 0, merges |-> 0,
     remoteMerge |-> "none", mergeOutcome |-> "none", proof |-> "none",
     status |-> "active", cause |-> "none", lost |-> {},
     outside |-> FALSE, externalMerged |-> FALSE, invalidated |-> FALSE]

FPhases == {"idle", "record-run", "start-run", "running", "run-result",
            "record-publication", "start-publication", "publication", "watch", "hold",
            "record-merge", "start-merge", "merge-response", "uncertain",
            "record-reopen", "start-reopen", "reopen-response", "done"}

FollowTypeOK ==
    IF lane = "ordinary" THEN follow = "inactive" ELSE
    /\ follow.scenario \in FollowCases \cup {"automatic", "undecided"}
    /\ follow.phase \in FPhases
    /\ follow.next \in FKinds
    /\ follow.op \in 0..MaxFollowOps
    /\ follow.kinds \in [FOps -> FKinds]
    /\ follow.bases \in [FOps -> Nat]
    /\ follow.rounds \in [FOps -> 0..1]
    /\ follow.starts \in [FOps -> Nat]
    /\ follow.raw \in [FOps -> FOutcomes]
    /\ follow.results \in [FOps -> FOutcomes]
    /\ follow.resultSnapshots \in [FOps -> Nat]
    /\ follow.snapshots \in Seq([identity : {FIdentity}, op : 0..MaxFollowOps,
         kind : FKinds, head : Nat, left : 0..2, round : 0..1,
         cause : FOutcomes \cup {"ci-failed", "closed"}, stage : STRING])
    /\ follow.intents \in [FEffects -> Nat]
    /\ follow.accepted \in Seq([identity : {FIdentity}, op : 0..MaxFollowOps,
         kind : FKinds, head : Nat, left : 0..2, round : 0..1,
         cause : FOutcomes \cup {"ci-failed", "closed"}, stage : STRING])
    /\ follow.cancelled \subseteq FEffects
    /\ follow.pending \subseteq FEffects
    /\ follow.completed \subseteq FEffects
    /\ follow.dispatches \in [FEffects -> Nat]
    /\ follow.charged \subseteq FOps
    /\ follow.left \in 0..2
    /\ follow.round \in 0..1
    /\ follow.holds \subseteq Nat
    /\ follow.requested \in BOOLEAN
    /\ follow.consumed \in Nat
    /\ follow.barrier \in 0..MaxFollowOps
    /\ follow.answers \in Nat
    /\ follow.owner \in Watchers \cup {NoOne}
    /\ follow.runFence \in Nat
    /\ follow.locals \in [Watchers -> [op : 0..MaxFollowOps, fence : Nat]]
    /\ follow.applied \in BOOLEAN
    /\ follow.checks \in BOOLEAN
    /\ follow.actors \subseteq Watchers
    /\ follow.rejected \in BOOLEAN
    /\ follow.publicationRefused \subseteq FOps
    /\ follow.externalDispatches \in [FOps -> Nat]
    /\ follow.remotePR \in {"none", "open", "closed", "merged"}
    /\ follow.knownPR \in {"none", "followup-pr"}
    /\ follow.creations \in Nat
    /\ follow.reopens \in Nat
    /\ follow.remoteHead \in Nat
    /\ follow.head \in Nat
    /\ follow.publications \in [FOps -> Nat]
    /\ follow.remoteCI \in {"none", "pass", "fail"}
    /\ follow.remoteCIHead \in Nat
    /\ follow.ci \in {"none", "pass", "fail"}
    /\ follow.ciHead \in Nat
    /\ follow.canMerge \in BOOLEAN
    /\ follow.mergeHead \in Nat
    /\ follow.merges \in Nat
    /\ follow.remoteMerge \in FOutcomes
    /\ follow.mergeOutcome \in FOutcomes
    /\ follow.proof \in {"none", "response", "observation"}
    /\ follow.status \in {"active", "closed", "exhausted", "merged", "refused", "unmergeable"}
    /\ follow.cause \in FOutcomes \cup {"ci-failed", "closed"}
    /\ follow.lost \subseteq FEffects
    /\ follow.remoteCanMerge \in BOOLEAN
    /\ follow.remoteMergeHead \in Nat
    /\ follow.externalMerged \in BOOLEAN
    /\ follow.outside \in BOOLEAN
    /\ follow.invalidated \in BOOLEAN

\* New safety statements; the ordinary statements below retain their text.
FollowSnapshotsKept ==
    lane = "followup" => (
     follow.snapshots = follow.accepted
    )

FollowOnePR ==
    lane = "followup" => (
     follow.creations <= 1
    )

FollowOperationOnce ==
    lane = "followup" => (
        /\ \A o \in FOps : follow.starts[o] <= 1
        /\ \A e \in FEffects : follow.dispatches[e] <= 1
    )

FollowOneMerge ==
    lane = "followup" => (
     follow.merges <= 1
    )

FollowWriterRequired ==
    lane = "followup" => (
        /\ follow.consumed > 0 => follow.requested
        /\ follow.reopens > 0 => follow.consumed > 0
        /\ \A h \in follow.holds, e \in FEffects :
            (e[2] # "answer" /\ follow.dispatches[e] > 0 /\ follow.intents[e] > h)
            => h < follow.consumed /\ follow.consumed <= follow.intents[e]
    )

FollowRenewalWaits ==
    lane = "followup" => (
        follow.consumed > 0 /\ follow.barrier > 0 =>
            follow.resultSnapshots[follow.barrier] > 0 /\
            follow.resultSnapshots[follow.barrier] < follow.consumed
    )

FollowSnapshotsBeforeEffects ==
    lane = "followup" => (
        \A e \in FEffects : follow.dispatches[e] > 0 =>
            /\ follow.intents[e] \in 1..Len(follow.snapshots)
            /\ follow.snapshots[follow.intents[e]].identity = FIdentity
            /\ follow.snapshots[follow.intents[e]].op = e[1]
    )

FollowEffectLedger ==
    lane = "followup" => (
        /\ follow.pending \cap follow.completed = {}
        /\ follow.cancelled \cap (follow.pending \cup follow.completed) = {}
        /\ follow.pending \cup follow.completed \cup follow.cancelled = {e \in FEffects : follow.intents[e] > 0}
        /\ \A e \in follow.completed : follow.dispatches[e] = 1
        /\ \A o \in FOps : follow.starts[o] = follow.dispatches[<<o, "run">>]
        /\ \A o \in FOps : follow.publications[o] > 0 => follow.dispatches[<<o, "publication">>] = 1
        /\ follow.creations = Cardinality({o \in FOps : follow.kinds[o] = "create" /\ follow.publications[o] > 0})
        /\ follow.reopens = Cardinality({o \in FOps : follow.dispatches[<<o, "reopen">>] = 1})
        /\ follow.knownPR # "none" => follow.creations = 1
        /\ follow.merges = (IF follow.remotePR = "merged" THEN 1 ELSE 0)
        /\ \A o \in FOps : follow.resultSnapshots[o] > 0 =>
            /\ follow.resultSnapshots[o] <= Len(follow.snapshots)
            /\ follow.snapshots[follow.resultSnapshots[o]].op = o
            /\ ~\E e \in follow.pending : e[1] = o
    )

FollowResultsCurrent ==
    lane = "followup" => (
     follow.applied
    )

FollowCurrentRevision ==
    lane = "followup" => (
        /\ follow.ci # "none" => follow.ciHead = follow.head
        /\ follow.canMerge => follow.mergeHead = follow.head
        /\ follow.checks
    )

FollowAllowance ==
    lane = "followup" => (
        /\ follow.charged = {o \in FOps : follow.kinds[o] = "repair"}
        /\ \A r \in 0..1 : Cardinality({o \in follow.charged : follow.rounds[o] = r}) <= 2
        /\ follow.left + Cardinality({o \in follow.charged : follow.rounds[o] = follow.round}) = 2
        /\ (follow.round = 1) = (follow.consumed > 0)
        /\ Cardinality({i \in 1..Len(follow.snapshots) : follow.snapshots[i].stage = "writer-renewal"}) =
            (IF follow.consumed > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0)
        /\ follow.consumed > 0 =>
            follow.snapshots[follow.consumed].left = 2 /\
            follow.snapshots[follow.consumed].stage = "writer-renewal"
    )

FollowFailurePreserved ==
    lane = "followup" => (
        \A o \in FOps :
            follow.raw[o] \in {"failed", "nochange", "stopped"} /\ follow.results[o] # "none"
            => follow.results[o] = follow.raw[o]
    )

FollowMergeConfirmed ==
    lane = "followup" => (
        /\ follow.status = "merged" =>
            follow.remotePR = "merged" /\ follow.merges = 1 /\ follow.proof # "none"
        /\ follow.mergeOutcome = "success" => follow.status = "merged"
        /\ follow.externalMerged /\ follow.remotePR = "merged" =>
            \A o \in FOps : follow.dispatches[<<o, "merge">>] = follow.externalDispatches[o]
    )

FollowAnswersOnce ==
    lane = "followup" => (
     follow.answers <= 1
    )

\* Statements about progress do not require a person, CI or GitHub to act.
FollowRunsSettled ==
    \A o \in FOps :
        (IF lane = "followup" THEN follow.starts[o] = 1 ELSE FALSE)
        ~> (IF lane = "followup" THEN follow.resultSnapshots[o] > 0 ELSE TRUE)

FollowPublicationsSettled ==
    \A o \in FOps :
        (IF lane = "followup" THEN follow.dispatches[<<o, "publication">>] = 1 ELSE FALSE)
        ~> (IF lane = "followup" THEN follow.resultSnapshots[o] > 0 ELSE TRUE)

FollowKnownMergesSettled ==
    /\ (IF lane = "followup" THEN follow.remotePR = "merged" ELSE FALSE)
        ~> (IF lane = "followup" THEN follow.status = "merged" ELSE TRUE)
    /\ (IF lane = "followup" THEN follow.remoteMerge = "refused" ELSE FALSE)
        ~> (IF lane = "followup" THEN follow.status \in {"merged", "refused"} ELSE TRUE)

FollowRequestsAnswered ==
    (IF lane = "followup" THEN follow.requested ELSE FALSE)
    ~> (IF lane = "followup" THEN follow.answers = 1 ELSE TRUE)

FollowAuthorizedWorkStarts ==
    \A o \in FOps :
        (IF lane = "followup" THEN follow.kinds[o] # "none" ELSE FALSE)
        ~> (IF lane = "followup" THEN
              follow.resultSnapshots[o] > 0 \/
              (\E k \in FEffectKinds : follow.dispatches[<<o, k>>] = 1)
            ELSE TRUE)

FollowAutomaticRetries ==
    \A o \in FOps :
        (IF lane = "followup" THEN
           follow.kinds[o] \in {"draft", "create"} /\ follow.resultSnapshots[o] > 0 /\
           follow.results[o] \in {"failed", "stopped", "refused"}
         ELSE FALSE)
        ~> (IF lane = "followup" THEN
              \E n \in FOps : n > o /\ follow.kinds[n] = follow.kinds[o] /\ follow.starts[n] = 1
            ELSE TRUE)

\* Witnesses name durable facts, not a chosen scenario or a program counter.
AutomaticDraftAndCreateRecovery ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
        /\ follow.publicationRefused # {}
        /\ follow.creations = 1
        /\ \E d, c \in FOps : follow.kinds[d] = "draft" /\ follow.results[d] # "success" /\
             follow.resultSnapshots[d] > 0 /\ follow.kinds[c] = "create" /\
             follow.results[c] # "success" /\ follow.resultSnapshots[c] > 0
    )

RepairAfterCIFailure ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
        follow.head >= 2 /\ follow.creations = 1 /\ Cardinality(follow.charged) >= 1
    )

ExhaustedThenRenewed ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
        follow.consumed > 0 /\ Cardinality({o \in follow.charged : follow.rounds[o] = 0}) = 2 /\
        \E o \in follow.charged : follow.rounds[o] = 1 /\ follow.publications[o] > 0
    )

ClosedFollowupResumed ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
     follow.reopens = 1 /\ follow.creations = 1 /\ follow.remotePR = "open"
    )

LostCreationAdoptsClosed ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
        follow.knownPR = "followup-pr" /\ follow.status = "closed" /\
        \E e \in follow.lost : e[2] = "publication" /\ follow.kinds[e[1]] = "create"
    )

LostCreationAdoptsMerged ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
        follow.knownPR = "followup-pr" /\ follow.status = "merged" /\
        \E e \in follow.lost : e[2] = "publication" /\ follow.kinds[e[1]] = "create"
    )

LostRepairPublicationRecovered ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
        \E e \in follow.lost : e[2] = "publication" /\ follow.kinds[e[1]] = "repair" /\
            follow.resultSnapshots[e[1]] > 0 /\ follow.dispatches[e] = 1
    )

LostMergeResponseRecovered ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
        follow.status = "merged" /\ crashes > 0 /\
        \E e \in follow.lost : e[2] = "merge" /\ e \in follow.completed
    )

UnknownMergeRecorded ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
     follow.mergeOutcome = "unknown" /\ follow.status # "merged"
    )

MergeRefusalReconciled ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
     follow.mergeOutcome = "refused" /\ follow.status = "refused"
    )

ExternalMergeObserved ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
        follow.status = "merged" /\ follow.proof = "observation" /\
        follow.externalMerged /\ follow.ci = "none"
    )

PendingRenewalReconciled ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
        follow.barrier > 0 /\ follow.consumed > follow.resultSnapshots[follow.barrier] /\
        follow.resultSnapshots[follow.barrier] > 0 /\ follow.left = 2 /\ follow.answers = 1
    )

FailedAndNoChangeRepairsRetained ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
        \E a, b \in follow.charged : follow.results[a] = "failed" /\ follow.results[b] = "nochange"
    )

InvalidatedRepairRetainsUsage ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
        \E o \in follow.charged : follow.results[o] = "invalidated" /\ follow.resultSnapshots[o] > 0
    )

TwoWatchersRecoverFollowup ==
    /\ lane = "followup"
    /\ (
        follow.status = "merged" /\ follow.actors = Watchers /\ crashes = MaxCrashes
    )

\* Model helpers. Each snapshot is an accepted Workflow state, stored in an
\* append-only journal. Effects carry the journal position that authorized them.
\* The adapter chooses none of the policy outcomes: bounded cases supply core
\* authorizations and agent/GitHub outcomes, including unsuccessful outcomes.
FBase == <<given, posts, retried, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed,
           codePushed, prs, pr, gate, mergeable, merges, pred, intent, watched, watchPosts,
           marked, lease, up, inRun, crashes>>

FFrame == UNCHANGED <<FBase, unleased, lane, fence>>

FHolding(w) == lane = "followup" /\ up[w] /\ lease = w

FKind == IF follow.op = 0 THEN "none" ELSE follow.kinds[follow.op]

FCount(k) == Cardinality({o \in FOps : follow.kinds[o] = k})

FRepairUnresolved ==
    FKind = "repair" /\ follow.resultSnapshots[follow.op] = 0

FAppend(op, kind, head, left, round, cause, stage) ==
    Append(follow.snapshots, FSnapshot(op, kind, head, left, round, cause, stage))

FCheck(w, e) ==
    /\ up[w] /\ lease = w
    /\ e[2] \in {"publication", "merge"} => follow.head = follow.remoteHead
    /\ e[2] = "merge" => follow.ci = "pass" /\ follow.ciHead = follow.head /\
         follow.canMerge /\ follow.mergeHead = follow.head

FAgentOutcome ==
    CASE follow.scenario = "automatic" /\ FKind = "draft" /\ FCount("draft") = 1 -> "failed"
      [] follow.scenario = "automatic" /\ FKind = "create" /\ FCount("create") = 1 -> "failed"
      [] follow.scenario = "exhaustion" /\ FKind = "repair" /\ FCount("repair") = 1 -> "failed"
      [] follow.scenario = "exhaustion" /\ FKind = "repair" /\ FCount("repair") = 2 -> "nochange"
      [] OTHER -> "success"

FAuthorize(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase = "idle"
    /\ ~(follow.requested /\ follow.consumed = 0)
    /\ follow.op < MaxFollowOps
    /\ follow.next = "repair" => follow.left > 0 /\ follow.remotePR = "open"
    /\ follow.next = "reopen" => follow.consumed > 0 /\ follow.remotePR = "closed"
    /\ LET o == follow.op + 1
           k == follow.next
           remaining == IF k = "repair" THEN follow.left - 1 ELSE follow.left
       IN follow' = [follow EXCEPT
           !.op = o, !.kinds[o] = k, !.bases[o] = follow.head, !.rounds[o] = follow.round,
           !.left = remaining, !.charged = IF k = "repair" THEN @ \cup {o} ELSE @,
           !.snapshots = FAppend(o, k, follow.head, remaining, follow.round, follow.cause, "authorized"), !.accepted = FAppend(o, k, follow.head, remaining, follow.round, follow.cause, "authorized"),
           !.phase = CASE k = "merge" -> "record-merge" [] k = "reopen" -> "record-reopen"
                          [] OTHER -> "record-run"]
    /\ FFrame

\* Nonautomatic outcomes have an identical prefix through the first successful
\* create run. Choose that external-outcome case only when it first matters.
FSelectScenario(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.scenario = "undecided"
    /\ follow.phase = "record-publication" /\ FKind = "create"
    /\ \E c \in FollowCases \ {"automatic"} : follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.scenario = c]
    /\ FFrame

FRecord(w, effect) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ effect = "publication" => follow.scenario # "undecided"
    /\ <<follow.phase, effect>> \in {<<"record-run", "run">>, <<"record-publication", "publication">>,
                                    <<"record-merge", "merge">>, <<"record-reopen", "reopen">>}
    /\ LET e == <<follow.op, effect>>
       IN /\ follow.intents[e] = 0
          /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.intents[e] = Len(follow.snapshots), !.pending = @ \cup {e},
              !.phase = CASE effect = "run" -> "start-run" [] effect = "publication" -> "start-publication"
                            [] effect = "merge" -> "start-merge" [] OTHER -> "start-reopen"]
    /\ FFrame

FStart(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase = "start-run"
    /\ LET o == follow.op
           e == <<o, "run">>
       IN follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.starts[o] = @ + 1, !.dispatches[e] = @ + 1,
           !.owner = w, !.runFence = fence,
           !.actors = @ \cup {w}, !.phase = "running"]
    /\ FFrame

FFinish(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase = "running"
    /\ follow.owner = w /\ follow.runFence = fence
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.raw[follow.op] = FAgentOutcome, !.phase = "run-result"]
    /\ FFrame

FRecoverStopped(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase = "running"
    /\ follow.owner # w \/ follow.runFence # fence
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.raw[follow.op] = "stopped", !.phase = "run-result"]
    /\ FFrame

FReconcileRun(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase = "run-result"
    /\ LET o == follow.op
           result == IF follow.raw[o] = "success" /\ FKind = "repair" /\ (follow.bases[o] # follow.remoteHead \/ follow.remotePR # "open")
                     THEN "invalidated" ELSE follow.raw[o]
           publish == result = "success" /\ FKind \in {"create", "repair"}
           hold == FKind = "repair" /\ ~publish /\ (follow.left = 0 \/ follow.remotePR = "closed")
           idx == Len(follow.snapshots) + 1
           newhead == IF result = "invalidated" THEN follow.remoteHead ELSE follow.head
       IN follow' = [follow EXCEPT
           !.results[o] = result, !.owner = NoOne, !.runFence = 0,
           !.applied = @ /\ (result # "success" \/ follow.bases[o] = newhead),
           !.completed = @ \cup {<<o, "run">>}, !.pending = @ \ {<<o, "run">>},
           !.resultSnapshots[o] = IF publish THEN 0 ELSE idx,
           !.snapshots = FAppend(o, FKind, newhead, follow.left, follow.round, result, "run-outcome"), !.accepted = FAppend(o, FKind, newhead, follow.left, follow.round, result, "run-outcome"),
           !.head = newhead, !.ci = IF result = "invalidated" THEN "none" ELSE @,
           !.ciHead = IF result = "invalidated" THEN 0 ELSE @,
           !.canMerge = IF result = "invalidated" THEN FALSE ELSE @,
           !.mergeHead = IF result = "invalidated" THEN 0 ELSE @,
           !.cause = IF result = "success" THEN @ ELSE result,
           !.phase = IF publish THEN "record-publication" ELSE IF hold THEN "hold" ELSE "idle",
           !.status = IF hold THEN IF follow.remotePR = "closed" THEN "closed" ELSE "exhausted" ELSE @,
           !.holds = IF hold THEN @ \cup {idx} ELSE @,
           !.next = IF FKind = "draft" /\ result = "success" THEN "create" ELSE FKind]
    /\ FFrame

FPublish(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase = "start-publication"
    /\ ~(follow.scenario = "automatic" /\ FKind = "create" /\ FCount("create") = 2)
    /\ FKind = "create" => follow.remotePR = "none"
    /\ FKind = "repair" => follow.remotePR = "open" /\ follow.bases[follow.op] = follow.remoteHead
    /\ LET o == follow.op
           e == <<o, "publication">>
           newhead == follow.remoteHead + 1
           lose == (FKind = "create" /\ follow.scenario \in {"lost-create-closed", "lost-create-merged"})
                    \/ (FKind = "repair" /\ follow.scenario = "lost-push")
       IN follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.dispatches[e] = @ + 1,
           !.checks = @ /\ FCheck(w, e), !.actors = @ \cup {w},
           !.remotePR = "open", !.creations = IF FKind = "create" THEN @ + 1 ELSE @,
           !.remoteHead = newhead, !.publications[o] = newhead,
           !.remoteCI = "none", !.remoteCIHead = 0, !.remoteCanMerge = FALSE, !.remoteMergeHead = 0,
           !.lost = IF lose THEN @ \cup {e} ELSE @, !.phase = "publication"]
    /\ FFrame

FReconcileSuperseded(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase \in {"record-publication", "start-publication", "record-merge", "start-merge"}
    /\ FKind \in {"repair", "merge"}
    /\ follow.bases[follow.op] # follow.remoteHead \/ follow.remotePR # "open"
    /\ LET o == follow.op
           e == <<o, IF FKind = "merge" THEN "merge" ELSE "publication">>
           idx == Len(follow.snapshots) + 1
           closed == follow.remotePR = "closed"
           merged == follow.remotePR = "merged"
           hold == closed \/ (FKind = "repair" /\ follow.left = 0 /\ ~merged)
           snap == FAppend(o, FKind, follow.remoteHead, follow.left, follow.round, "invalidated", "superseded-outcome")
       IN follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.results[o] = "invalidated", !.cause = "invalidated",
           !.resultSnapshots[o] = idx, !.head = follow.remoteHead,
           !.ci = "none", !.ciHead = 0, !.canMerge = FALSE, !.mergeHead = 0,
           !.snapshots = snap, !.accepted = snap,
           !.pending = @ \ {e}, !.cancelled = IF follow.intents[e] > 0 THEN @ \cup {e} ELSE @,
           !.phase = IF merged THEN "done" ELSE IF hold THEN "hold" ELSE IF FKind = "merge" THEN "watch" ELSE "idle",
           !.next = "repair", !.proof = IF merged THEN "observation" ELSE @,
           !.status = IF merged THEN "merged" ELSE IF closed THEN "closed" ELSE IF hold THEN "exhausted" ELSE @,
           !.holds = IF hold THEN @ \cup {idx} ELSE @]
    /\ FFrame

FPublicationRefusal(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase = "start-publication"
    /\ follow.scenario = "automatic" /\ FKind = "create" /\ FCount("create") = 2
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.dispatches[<<follow.op, "publication">>] = @ + 1,
           !.publicationRefused = @ \cup {follow.op}, !.actors = @ \cup {w}, !.phase = "publication"]
    /\ FFrame

FReconcileCreationRefusal(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase = "publication" /\ follow.op \in follow.publicationRefused
    /\ LET o == follow.op
           snap == FAppend(o, FKind, follow.head, follow.left, follow.round, "refused", "creation-outcome")
       IN follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.pending = @ \ {<<o, "publication">>},
           !.completed = @ \cup {<<o, "publication">>}, !.resultSnapshots[o] = Len(follow.snapshots) + 1,
           !.results[o] = "refused", !.cause = "refused", !.phase = "idle", !.next = "create",
           !.snapshots = snap, !.accepted = snap]
    /\ FFrame

FReconcilePublication(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase = "publication"
    /\ follow.publications[follow.op] > 0
    /\ LET o == follow.op
           idx == Len(follow.snapshots) + 1
           closed == follow.remotePR = "closed"
           merged == follow.remotePR = "merged"
       IN follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.knownPR = "followup-pr", !.head = follow.remoteHead,
           !.ci = "none", !.ciHead = 0, !.canMerge = FALSE, !.mergeHead = 0,
           !.completed = @ \cup {<<o, "publication">>}, !.pending = @ \ {<<o, "publication">>},
           !.resultSnapshots[o] = idx,
           !.snapshots = FAppend(o, FKind, follow.remoteHead, follow.left, follow.round, follow.cause, "publication-outcome"), !.accepted = FAppend(o, FKind, follow.remoteHead, follow.left, follow.round, follow.cause, "publication-outcome"),
           !.phase = IF merged THEN "done" ELSE IF closed THEN "hold" ELSE "watch",
           !.status = IF merged THEN "merged" ELSE IF closed THEN "closed" ELSE "active",
           !.proof = IF merged THEN "observation" ELSE @,
           !.holds = IF closed THEN @ \cup {idx} ELSE @]
    /\ FFrame

FObservePR(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ (follow.phase = "watch" \/ (follow.phase = "done" /\ follow.status = "refused"))
    /\ follow.remotePR \in {"closed", "merged"}
    /\ LET idx == Len(follow.snapshots) + 1
           closed == follow.remotePR = "closed"
       IN follow' = [follow EXCEPT
           !.phase = IF closed THEN "hold" ELSE "done",
           !.status = IF closed THEN "closed" ELSE "merged",
           !.proof = IF closed THEN @ ELSE "observation",
           !.holds = IF closed THEN @ \cup {idx} ELSE @,
           !.snapshots = FAppend(follow.op, FKind, follow.head, follow.left, follow.round, follow.cause, "pr-observation"), !.accepted = FAppend(follow.op, FKind, follow.head, follow.left, follow.round, follow.cause, "pr-observation")]
    /\ FFrame

FObserveCI(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase = "watch"
    /\ follow.remotePR = "open"
    /\ follow.remoteCI # "none" /\ follow.remoteCIHead = follow.head
    /\ follow.remoteMergeHead = follow.head
    /\ LET failed == follow.remoteCI = "fail"
           hold == failed /\ follow.left = 0
           unmergeable == ~failed /\ ~follow.remoteCanMerge
           idx == Len(follow.snapshots) + 1
       IN follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.ci = follow.remoteCI, !.ciHead = follow.head,
           !.canMerge = follow.remoteCanMerge, !.mergeHead = follow.remoteMergeHead,
           !.phase = IF unmergeable THEN "done" ELSE IF hold THEN "hold" ELSE "idle",
           !.next = IF failed THEN "repair" ELSE "merge",
           !.status = IF unmergeable THEN "unmergeable" ELSE IF hold THEN "exhausted" ELSE @,
           !.holds = IF hold THEN @ \cup {idx} ELSE @,
           !.cause = IF failed THEN "ci-failed" ELSE @,
           !.snapshots = FAppend(follow.op, FKind, follow.head, follow.left, follow.round,
                                IF failed THEN "ci-failed" ELSE follow.cause, "ci-observation"), !.accepted = FAppend(follow.op, FKind, follow.head, follow.left, follow.round,
                                IF failed THEN "ci-failed" ELSE follow.cause, "ci-observation")]
    /\ FFrame

FConsumeRequest(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.requested /\ follow.consumed = 0
    /\ ~FRepairUnresolved
    /\ follow.phase \in {"hold", "idle", "watch"}
    /\ LET idx == Len(follow.snapshots) + 1
           closed == follow.remotePR = "closed"
       IN follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.consumed = idx, !.round = 1, !.left = 2,
           !.snapshots = FAppend(0, "none", follow.head, 2, 1, follow.cause, "writer-renewal"), !.accepted = FAppend(0, "none", follow.head, 2, 1, follow.cause, "writer-renewal"),
           !.phase = IF closed \/ follow.status = "exhausted" THEN "idle" ELSE @,
           !.next = IF closed THEN "reopen" ELSE IF follow.status = "exhausted" THEN "repair" ELSE @,
           !.status = "active"]
    /\ FFrame

FRecordAnswer(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.consumed > 0 /\ follow.intents[<<0, "answer">>] = 0
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.intents[<<0, "answer">>] = follow.consumed,
                               !.pending = @ \cup {<<0, "answer">>}]
    /\ FFrame

FAnswer(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ <<0, "answer">> \in follow.pending
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.answers = @ + 1, !.dispatches[<<0, "answer">>] = @ + 1,
           !.pending = @ \ {<<0, "answer">>}, !.completed = @ \cup {<<0, "answer">>},
           !.actors = @ \cup {w}]
    /\ FFrame

FReopen(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase = "start-reopen"
    /\ follow.remotePR = "closed" /\ follow.consumed > 0
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.remotePR = "open", !.reopens = @ + 1,
           !.dispatches[<<follow.op, "reopen">>] = @ + 1,
           !.actors = @ \cup {w}, !.phase = "reopen-response"]
    /\ FFrame

FReconcileReopen(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase = "reopen-response"
    /\ LET o == follow.op
       IN follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.pending = @ \ {<<o, "reopen">>},
           !.completed = @ \cup {<<o, "reopen">>}, !.resultSnapshots[o] = Len(follow.snapshots) + 1,
           !.results[o] = "success", !.phase = "watch",
           !.snapshots = FAppend(o, FKind, follow.head, follow.left, follow.round, follow.cause, "reopen-outcome"), !.accepted = FAppend(o, FKind, follow.head, follow.left, follow.round, follow.cause, "reopen-outcome")]
    /\ FFrame

FMerge(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase = "start-merge"
    /\ follow.remotePR = "open" /\ follow.head = follow.remoteHead
    /\ follow.ci = "pass" /\ follow.ciHead = follow.head
    /\ follow.canMerge /\ follow.mergeHead = follow.head
    /\ LET e == <<follow.op, "merge">>
           result == CASE follow.scenario \in {"refused-merge", "refused-external"} -> "refused"
                          [] follow.scenario = "unknown-merge" -> "unknown" [] OTHER -> "success"
       IN follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.dispatches[e] = @ + 1,
           !.checks = @ /\ FCheck(w, e), !.actors = @ \cup {w},
           !.remoteMerge = result, !.phase = "merge-response",
           !.remotePR = IF result = "success" THEN "merged" ELSE @,
           !.merges = IF result = "success" THEN @ + 1 ELSE @,
           !.lost = IF follow.scenario \in {"lost-merge", "unknown-merge"} THEN @ \cup {e} ELSE @]
    /\ FFrame

FReconcileMerge(w) ==
    /\ FHolding(w)
    /\ follow.phase \in {"merge-response", "uncertain"}
    /\ follow.phase = "uncertain" => follow.remoteMerge # "unknown"
    /\ LET o == follow.op
           result == IF follow.remotePR = "merged" THEN "success" ELSE follow.remoteMerge
           terminal == result # "unknown"
       IN follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.mergeOutcome = result, !.results[o] = result,
           !.phase = IF terminal THEN "done" ELSE "uncertain",
           !.status = CASE result = "success" -> "merged" [] result = "refused" -> "refused" [] OTHER -> @,
           !.cause = IF result = "refused" THEN "refused" ELSE @,
           !.proof = IF result = "success" THEN
                        IF <<o, "merge">> \in follow.lost THEN "observation" ELSE "response" ELSE @,
           !.pending = IF terminal THEN @ \ {<<o, "merge">>} ELSE @,
           !.completed = IF terminal THEN @ \cup {<<o, "merge">>} ELSE @,
           !.resultSnapshots[o] = IF terminal THEN Len(follow.snapshots) + 1 ELSE 0,
           !.snapshots = FAppend(o, FKind, follow.head, follow.left, follow.round, result, "merge-outcome"), !.accepted = FAppend(o, FKind, follow.head, follow.left, follow.round, result, "merge-outcome")]
    /\ FFrame

FollowAct(w) ==
    \/ FSelectScenario(w)
    \/ FAuthorize(w)
    \/ \E k \in FEffectKinds : FRecord(w, k)
    \/ FStart(w) \/ FFinish(w) \/ FRecoverStopped(w) \/ FReconcileRun(w)
    \/ FPublish(w) \/ FReconcileSuperseded(w) \/ FReconcilePublication(w)
    \/ FPublicationRefusal(w) \/ FReconcileCreationRefusal(w)
    \/ FObservePR(w) \/ FObserveCI(w)
    \/ FConsumeRequest(w) \/ FRecordAnswer(w) \/ FAnswer(w)
    \/ FReopen(w) \/ FReconcileReopen(w)
    \/ FMerge(w) \/ FReconcileMerge(w)

FGiveRequest ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ ~follow.requested
    /\ \/ follow.scenario \in {"exhaustion", "closed"} /\ follow.phase = "hold"
       \/ follow.scenario = "pending-resume" /\ FRepairUnresolved /\
          follow.phase \in {"running", "run-result", "record-publication", "start-publication", "publication"}
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.requested = TRUE,
                   !.barrier = IF FRepairUnresolved THEN follow.op ELSE 0]
    /\ FFrame

FCIEvent ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ follow.phase = "watch" /\ follow.remotePR = "open"
    /\ follow.remoteCI = "none"
    /\ follow.scenario \notin {"external", "closed", "lost-create-closed", "lost-create-merged"}
        \/ follow.reopens > 0
    /\ LET fail == FCount("repair") = 0 /\ follow.scenario \in
                     {"repair", "exhaustion", "lost-push", "invalidated", "pending-resume", "repair-closed"}
       IN follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.remoteCI = IF fail THEN "fail" ELSE "pass",
                                  !.remoteCIHead = follow.remoteHead,
                                  !.remoteCanMerge = follow.scenario # "unmergeable", !.remoteMergeHead = follow.remoteHead]
    /\ FFrame

FExternalClose ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ ~follow.outside /\ follow.remotePR = "open"
    /\ \/ follow.scenario = "closed" /\ follow.phase = "watch"
       \/ follow.scenario = "lost-create-closed" /\ follow.phase = "publication" /\ FKind = "create"
       \/ follow.scenario = "repair-closed" /\ FKind = "repair" /\ follow.phase \in {"running", "run-result", "record-publication", "start-publication"}
       \/ follow.scenario = "merge-closed" /\ follow.phase \in {"record-merge", "start-merge"}
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.remotePR = "closed", !.outside = TRUE]
    /\ FFrame

FExternalMerge ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ ~follow.outside /\ follow.remotePR = "open"
    /\ \/ follow.scenario = "external" /\ follow.phase = "watch"
       \/ follow.scenario = "lost-create-merged" /\ follow.phase = "publication" /\ FKind = "create"
       \/ follow.scenario = "merge-external" /\ follow.phase \in {"record-merge", "start-merge"}
       \/ follow.scenario = "refused-external" /\ follow.status = "refused"
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.remotePR = "merged", !.merges = @ + 1, !.outside = TRUE, !.externalMerged = TRUE,
          !.externalDispatches = [o \in FOps |-> follow.dispatches[<<o, "merge">>]]]
    /\ FFrame

FInvalidateHead ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ ~follow.invalidated
    /\ \/ follow.scenario = "invalidated" /\ FKind = "repair" /\ follow.phase \in {"running", "run-result", "record-publication", "start-publication"}
       \/ follow.scenario = "merge-head" /\ follow.phase \in {"record-merge", "start-merge"}
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.remoteHead = @ + 1, !.remoteCI = "none", !.remoteCIHead = 0, !.remoteCanMerge = FALSE, !.remoteMergeHead = 0,
                               !.invalidated = TRUE]
    /\ FFrame

FResolveUnknown(result) ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ follow.phase = "uncertain" /\ follow.remoteMerge = "unknown"
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.remoteMerge = result,
           !.remotePR = IF result = "success" THEN "merged" ELSE @,
           !.merges = IF result = "success" THEN @ + 1 ELSE @]
    /\ FFrame

FollowOutside ==
    \/ FGiveRequest \/ FCIEvent \/ FExternalClose \/ FExternalMerge \/ FInvalidateHead
    \/ \E r \in {"success", "refused"} : FResolveUnknown(r)

\* Fault injections are realistic adapter mistakes and are not Next actions.
DuplicateFollowCreation ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ follow.phase = "publication" /\ FKind = "create"
    /\ follow.remotePR \in {"closed", "merged"}
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.creations = @ + 1, !.remotePR = "open"]
    /\ FFrame

DuplicateFollowRun ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ follow.op > 0 /\ follow.raw[follow.op] = "stopped"
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.starts[follow.op] = @ + 1,
                               !.dispatches[<<follow.op, "run">>] = @ + 1]
    /\ FFrame

DuplicateFollowMerge ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ follow.status = "merged"
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.merges = @ + 1]
    /\ FFrame

ApplyStaleRepairResult ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ FKind = "repair" /\ follow.phase = "running"
    /\ \E o \in FOps : o < follow.op /\ follow.starts[o] = 1 /\
         follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.applied = @ /\ (o = follow.op)]
    /\ FFrame

DispatchWithoutRecord ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ follow.phase = "record-run"
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.starts[follow.op] = @ + 1,
                               !.dispatches[<<follow.op, "run">>] = @ + 1]
    /\ FFrame

FollowEffectAfterLeaseLoss ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ follow.phase = "running"
    /\ follow.owner # lease
    /\ unleased' = unleased \cup {follow.owner}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<FBase, lane, fence, follow>>

ReuseFollowCI ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ follow.head >= 2
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.ci = "pass", !.ciHead = follow.head - 1,
                               !.canMerge = TRUE, !.mergeHead = follow.head - 1]
    /\ FFrame

ResumeWithoutWriter ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ follow.phase = "hold" /\ ~follow.requested
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.consumed = Len(follow.snapshots) + 1,
           !.round = 1, !.left = 2, !.phase = "idle", !.status = "active",
           !.next = IF follow.remotePR = "closed" THEN "reopen" ELSE "repair",
           !.snapshots = FAppend(0, "none", follow.head, 2, 1, follow.cause, "writer-renewal"), !.accepted = FAppend(0, "none", follow.head, 2, 1, follow.cause, "writer-renewal")]
    /\ FFrame

RenewBeforeReconciliation ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ follow.requested /\ follow.consumed = 0 /\ FRepairUnresolved
    /\ follow.barrier > 0
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.consumed = Len(follow.snapshots) + 1, !.round = 1, !.left = 2,
           !.snapshots = FAppend(0, "none", follow.head, 2, 1, follow.cause, "writer-renewal"), !.accepted = FAppend(0, "none", follow.head, 2, 1, follow.cause, "writer-renewal")]
    /\ FFrame

TreatAuthorizationAsMerge ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ follow.phase = "record-merge"
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.status = "merged", !.mergeOutcome = "success"]
    /\ FFrame

ChargeLostPushAgain ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ follow.phase = "publication" /\ FKind = "repair"
    /\ <<follow.op, "publication">> \in follow.lost /\ follow.left > 0
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.left = @ - 1]
    /\ FFrame

HideRepairFailure ==
    /\ lane = "followup" /\ FKind = "repair" /\ follow.results[follow.op] = "nochange"
    /\ follow' = [follow EXCEPT !.results[follow.op] = "failed"]
    /\ FFrame

TypeOK ==
    /\ given \subseteq Cmds
    /\ posts \in [Keys -> Nat]
    /\ retried \in BOOLEAN
    /\ retryPosts \in Nat
    /\ buildPosts \in Nat
    /\ runs \in [RunKeys -> {"none", "recorded", "done"}]
    /\ runStarts \in [RunKeys -> Nat]
    /\ ratPushed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ codePushed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ prs \in Nat
    /\ pr \in {"none", "draft", "ready", "closed", "merged"}
    /\ gate \in {"none", "pass"}
    /\ mergeable \in BOOLEAN
    /\ merges \in Nat
    /\ pred \in {"none", "draft", "retired", "closed", "merged"}
    /\ intent \in BOOLEAN
    /\ watched \in BOOLEAN
    /\ watchPosts \in Nat
    /\ marked \in BOOLEAN
    /\ lease \in Watchers \cup {NoOne}
    /\ up \in [Watchers -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ inRun \in [Watchers -> RunKeys \cup {"none", "stale"}]
    /\ crashes \in 0..MaxCrashes
    /\ unleased \subseteq Watchers
    /\ lane \in {"ordinary", "followup"}
    /\ fence \in Nat
    /\ FollowTypeOK

NoDoubleAnswer ==
    /\ \A k \in Keys : posts[k] <= 1
    /\ retryPosts <= 1
    /\ watchPosts <= 1
    /\ buildPosts <= 1

NoRunTwice == \A k \in RunKeys : runStarts[k] <= 1

OnePullRequest == prs <= 1

OneOpenPullRequest == ~(pr \in {"draft", "ready"} /\ pred = "draft")

RetiredOnlyByRecord == pred = "retired" => intent

NoReplacingMerged == pred = "merged" => runs["build"] = "none" /\ prs = 0

OwnGate == gate = "pass" => prs >= 1

OwnRun == runs["build"] # "none" => runStarts["build"] >= 1

OneMerge == merges <= 1

OnlyHolderActs == unleased = {}

MergeOnlyAfterGate == merges >= 1 => gate = "pass" /\ mergeable

ReadiedOnlyWhenWatched == marked => watched /\ watchPosts >= 1

ReadiedOnlyAfterGate == marked => gate = "pass" /\ mergeable

\* Helpers, computed only from what every watcher can see.

\* The step for k has been asked for: a command was given, or the gate passed
\* on a pull request that isn't a failed draft, or on a failed draft that a
\* writer's retry watches again, once that retry is answered.
Triggered(k) ==
    CASE k \in Cmds -> k \in given
      [] k = "merge" -> gate = "pass" /\ (pr # "draft" \/ (watched /\ watchPosts >= 1))

\* A step is open until a post answers it; the post is always its last effect.
Active(k) == Triggered(k) /\ posts[k] = 0

\* Every effect of step k that comes before its post is already there.
EffectsDone(k) ==
    CASE k = "solve" -> runs["solve"] = "done"
      [] k = "ratify" -> ratPushed
      [] k = "merge" -> merges >= 1 \/ ~mergeable \/ pr \in {"closed", "merged"}
      [] k = "note" -> TRUE

\* The latest retry is still to be answered.
RetryActive == retried /\ retryPosts = 0

\* The retry that watches the latest build's failed draft again is still to
\* be answered.
WatchActive == watched /\ watchPosts = 0

\* The latest retry builds again: nothing was left to replace, or its record
\* says it replaces the draft, which is closed. A retry whose draft someone
\* merged, or closed before the record was stored, is answered without one.
Replacing == pred = "none" \/ (intent /\ pred \in {"retired", "closed"})

\* The latest build has been asked for: by the ratification's answer, or by
\* the latest retry's answer when that retry builds again.
BuildDue == IF retried THEN retryPosts >= 1 /\ Replacing ELSE posts["ratify"] >= 1

\* The latest build is asked for and no post answers it yet.
BuildActive == BuildDue /\ buildPosts = 0

MergeDone == merges >= 1 \/ posts["merge"] >= 1

\* Witnesses.

Merged == merges = 1 /\ posts["merge"] = 1

ReportedUnmergeable == gate = "pass" /\ ~mergeable /\ posts["merge"] = 1

StoppedRunReported == ~retried /\ runs["build"] = "recorded" /\ buildPosts = 1

RetryBuilt == retried /\ pred = "none" /\ prs = 1 /\ buildPosts = 1

RecoveredAfterCrashes == crashes = MaxCrashes /\ Merged

Replaced == pred = "retired" /\ prs = 1 /\ buildPosts = 1

ReplacedAndMerged == pred = "retired" /\ Merged

FailedAgain == retried /\ pr = "draft" /\ buildPosts = 1

StoppedAfterRetiring == pred = "retired" /\ runs["build"] = "recorded" /\ buildPosts = 1

MergedDraftKept == pred = "merged" /\ retryPosts = 1

ClosedDraftNoted == pred = "closed" /\ ~intent /\ retryPosts = 1

WatchedBeforeGate == watched /\ watchPosts = 1 /\ gate = "none"

WatchedAndMerged == watched /\ marked /\ Merged

WatchedButUnmergeable == watched /\ ~marked /\ gate = "pass" /\ ~mergeable /\ posts["merge"] = 1

\* Properties.

CommandsAnswered ==
    /\ \A c \in Cmds : c \in given ~> posts[c] >= 1
    /\ RetryActive ~> retryPosts >= 1
    /\ WatchActive ~> watchPosts >= 1

BuildsAnswered == BuildActive ~> buildPosts >= 1

GatedPullRequestsSettled == (gate = "pass" /\ pr # "draft") ~> MergeDone

WatchedDraftsSettled == (gate = "pass" /\ pr = "draft" /\ watched) ~> MergeDone

\* The model.

Init ==
    /\ lane \in {"ordinary", "followup"}
    /\ fence = 0
    /\ follow \in IF lane = "ordinary" THEN {"inactive"} ELSE {FollowInitial(c) : c \in {"automatic", "undecided"}}
    /\ given = {}
    /\ posts = [k \in Keys |-> 0]
    /\ retried = FALSE
    /\ retryPosts = 0
    /\ buildPosts = 0
    /\ runs = [k \in RunKeys |-> "none"]
    /\ runStarts = [k \in RunKeys |-> 0]
    /\ ratPushed = FALSE
    /\ codePushed = FALSE
    /\ prs = 0
    /\ pr = "none"
    /\ gate = "none"
    /\ mergeable = FALSE
    /\ merges = 0
    /\ pred = "none"
    /\ intent = FALSE
    /\ watched = FALSE
    /\ watchPosts = 0
    /\ marked = FALSE
    /\ lease = NoOne
    /\ up = [w \in Watchers |-> TRUE]
    /\ inRun = [w \in Watchers |-> "none"]
    /\ crashes = 0
    /\ unleased = {}

\* What the issue, its branch and its pull requests show every watcher.
Shared == <<given, posts, retried, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed,
            codePushed, prs, pr, gate, mergeable, merges, pred, intent, watched, watchPosts,
            marked>>

\* A writer gives a command the issue protocol allows.
Give(c) ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ c \notin given
        /\ c = "ratify" => posts["solve"] >= 1
        /\ given' = given \cup {c}
        /\ UNCHANGED <<posts, retried, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed,
                       codePushed, prs, pr, gate, mergeable, merges, pred, intent, watched,
                       watchPosts, marked, lease, up, inRun, crashes, unleased>>
       )

\* A writer's retry, once the latest build was answered and stopped or left a
\* failed draft: a new build, with its own agent run, that replaces that
\* draft. After a build that stopped, the draft an earlier retry replaced is
\* still the one this retry replaces, as that retry's record says. The
\* factory takes up an issue's commands in turn, so a retry comes once every
\* command before it is answered. A draft a writer's retry watches again is
\* never replaced.
GiveRetry ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ buildPosts >= 1
        /\ pr \in {"none", "draft"}
        /\ ~watched
        /\ merges = 0
        /\ \A k \in Keys : ~Active(k)
        /\ retried' = TRUE
        /\ retryPosts' = 0
        /\ buildPosts' = 0
        /\ pred' = IF pr = "draft" THEN "draft" ELSE pred
        /\ intent' = IF pr = "draft" THEN FALSE ELSE intent
        /\ runs' = [runs EXCEPT !["build"] = "none"]
        /\ runStarts' = [runStarts EXCEPT !["build"] = 0]
        /\ inRun' = [w \in Watchers |-> IF inRun[w] = "build" THEN "stale" ELSE inRun[w]]
        /\ codePushed' = FALSE
        /\ prs' = 0
        /\ pr' = "none"
        /\ gate' = "none"
        /\ mergeable' = FALSE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<given, posts, ratPushed, merges, watched, watchPosts, marked, lease, up,
                       crashes, unleased>>
       )

\* A writer's retry that watches the latest build's failed draft again, as a
\* modeled project's is: it starts no build. Once the retry is answered and
\* CI's gate passes on the draft, the factory marks the draft ready and
\* merges it, or reports one it can't merge: GitHub refuses it, or it changes
\* the trusted base, which only a person merges. The factory takes up an
\* issue's commands in turn, so the retry comes once every command before it
\* is answered.
GiveWatch ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ buildPosts >= 1
        /\ pr = "draft"
        /\ ~watched
        /\ merges = 0
        /\ \A k \in Keys : ~Active(k)
        /\ watched' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<given, posts, retried, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed,
                       codePushed, prs, pr, gate, mergeable, merges, pred, intent, watchPosts,
                       marked, lease, up, inRun, crashes, unleased>>
       )

\* CI's gate passes on the latest build's pull request; GitHub may or may not
\* be able to merge it.
CIPass ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ pr \in {"draft", "ready"}
        /\ gate = "none"
        /\ gate' = "pass"
        /\ mergeable' \in BOOLEAN
        /\ UNCHANGED <<given, posts, retried, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts,
                       ratPushed, codePushed, prs, pr, merges, pred, intent, watched, watchPosts,
                       marked, lease, up, inRun, crashes, unleased>>
       )

\* Someone else closes an open pull request: the latest build's, or the draft
\* a retry replaces.
OthersClose ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ \/ /\ pr \in {"draft", "ready"}
              /\ pr' = "closed"
              /\ UNCHANGED pred
           \/ /\ pred = "draft"
              /\ pred' = "closed"
              /\ UNCHANGED pr
        /\ UNCHANGED <<given, posts, retried, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts,
                       ratPushed, codePushed, prs, gate, mergeable, merges, intent, watched,
                       watchPosts, marked, lease, up, inRun, crashes, unleased>>
       )

\* Someone else merges an open pull request.
OthersMerge ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ \/ /\ pr \in {"draft", "ready"}
              /\ pr' = "merged"
              /\ UNCHANGED pred
           \/ /\ pred = "draft"
              /\ pred' = "merged"
              /\ UNCHANGED pr
        /\ UNCHANGED <<given, posts, retried, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts,
                       ratPushed, codePushed, prs, gate, mergeable, merges, intent, watched,
                       watchPosts, marked, lease, up, inRun, crashes, unleased>>
       )

Acquire(w) ==
    /\ (crashes > 0 \/ w = CHOOSE v \in Watchers : TRUE)
    /\ up[w]
    /\ lease = NoOne
    /\ lease' = w
    /\ UNCHANGED <<Shared, up, inRun, crashes, unleased>>
    /\ fence' = IF lane = "ordinary" THEN fence ELSE fence + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, follow>>

\* A lease whose holder is down is no longer renewed, and runs out.
Expire ==
    /\ lease # NoOne
    /\ ~up[lease]
    /\ lease' = NoOne
    /\ UNCHANGED <<Shared, up, inRun, crashes, unleased>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>

\* A watcher crashes, between effects or during an agent run; some other watcher keeps running.
Crash(w) ==
    /\ (lane = "ordinary" \/ crashes < FollowCrashLimit \/
         (follow.scenario = "lost-push" /\ follow.phase = "publication" /\ FKind = "repair"))
    /\ up[w]
    /\ crashes < MaxCrashes
    /\ \E v \in Watchers \ {w} : up[v]
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![w] = FALSE]
    /\ inRun' = [inRun EXCEPT ![w] = "none"]
    /\ crashes' = crashes + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<Shared, lease, unleased>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>

\* The holder stalls, say its laptop sleeps, past its lease; it wakes still running.
Stall(w) ==
    /\ (lane = "ordinary" \/ crashes < FollowCrashLimit \/
         (follow.scenario = "lost-push" /\ follow.phase = "publication" /\ FKind = "repair"))
    /\ up[w]
    /\ lease = w
    /\ crashes < MaxCrashes
    /\ lease' = NoOne
    /\ crashes' = crashes + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<Shared, up, inRun, unleased>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>

\* A crashed watcher restarts, remembering nothing.
Restart(w) ==
    /\ ~up[w]
    /\ lease # w
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![w] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<Shared, lease, inRun, crashes, unleased>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>

\* A watcher may take an effect: it is running, holds the lease, and isn't waiting on a run.
Holding(w) == up[w] /\ lease = w /\ inRun[w] = "none"

EffectVars == <<given, retried, gate, mergeable, watched, lease, up, crashes, unleased>>

\* Record the agent run, then start it: the draft's, or the latest build's.
StartRun(w, k) ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ Holding(w)
        /\ \/ k = "solve" /\ Active("solve")
           \/ k = "build" /\ BuildActive
        /\ runs[k] = "none"
        /\ runs' = [runs EXCEPT ![k] = "recorded"]
        /\ runStarts' = [runStarts EXCEPT ![k] = @ + 1]
        /\ inRun' = [inRun EXCEPT ![w] = k]
        /\ UNCHANGED <<posts, retryPosts, buildPosts, ratPushed, codePushed, prs, pr, merges,
                       pred, intent>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<watchPosts, marked>>
        /\ UNCHANGED EffectVars
       )

\* A run recorded and never finished stopped partway: say so, and start no other.
ReportStopped(w, k) ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ Holding(w)
        /\ runs[k] = "recorded"
        /\ \/ /\ k = "solve"
              /\ Active("solve")
              /\ posts' = [posts EXCEPT !["solve"] = @ + 1]
              /\ UNCHANGED buildPosts
           \/ /\ k = "build"
              /\ BuildActive
              /\ buildPosts' = buildPosts + 1
              /\ UNCHANGED posts
        /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed, codePushed, prs, pr, merges,
                       pred, intent, inRun>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<watchPosts, marked>>
        /\ UNCHANGED EffectVars
       )

PushRatification(w) ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ Holding(w)
        /\ Active("ratify")
        /\ ~ratPushed
        /\ ratPushed' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<posts, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts, codePushed, prs, pr,
                       merges, pred, intent, inRun>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<watchPosts, marked>>
        /\ UNCHANGED EffectVars
       )

\* Before closing the draft a retry replaces, store the retry's record that
\* it replaces it, where every watcher can read it.
RecordIntent(w) ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ Holding(w)
        /\ RetryActive
        /\ pred = "draft"
        /\ ~intent
        /\ intent' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<posts, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed, codePushed,
                       prs, pr, merges, pred, inRun>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<watchPosts, marked>>
        /\ UNCHANGED EffectVars
       )

\* Close the draft the retry replaces, as its record says.
Retire(w) ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ Holding(w)
        /\ RetryActive
        /\ pred = "draft"
        /\ intent
        /\ pred' = "retired"
        /\ UNCHANGED <<posts, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed, codePushed,
                       prs, pr, merges, intent, inRun>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<watchPosts, marked>>
        /\ UNCHANGED EffectVars
       )

PushCode(w) ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ Holding(w)
        /\ BuildActive
        /\ runs["build"] = "done"
        /\ ~codePushed
        /\ codePushed' = TRUE
        /\ UNCHANGED <<posts, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed, prs, pr,
                       merges, pred, intent, inRun>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<watchPosts, marked>>
        /\ UNCHANGED EffectVars
       )

\* Open the latest build's pull request: ready when its checks and review
\* passed, and a draft when they didn't.
OpenPullRequest(w, ready) ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ Holding(w)
        /\ BuildActive
        /\ runs["build"] = "done"
        /\ codePushed
        /\ prs = 0
        /\ prs' = prs + 1
        /\ pr' = IF ready THEN "ready" ELSE "draft"
        /\ UNCHANGED <<posts, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed, codePushed,
                       merges, pred, intent, inRun>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<watchPosts, marked>>
        /\ UNCHANGED EffectVars
       )

MergePullRequest(w) ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ Holding(w)
        /\ Active("merge")
        /\ mergeable
        /\ pr = "ready"
        /\ merges = 0
        /\ merges' = merges + 1
        /\ pr' = "merged"
        /\ UNCHANGED <<posts, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed, codePushed,
                       prs, pred, intent, inRun>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<watchPosts, marked>>
        /\ UNCHANGED EffectVars
       )

\* The post that answers step k, once no answer is there yet.
Post(w, k) ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ Holding(w)
        /\ Active(k)
        /\ EffectsDone(k)
        /\ posts' = [posts EXCEPT ![k] = @ + 1]
        /\ UNCHANGED <<retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed, codePushed, prs, pr,
                       merges, pred, intent, inRun>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<watchPosts, marked>>
        /\ UNCHANGED EffectVars
       )

\* Answer the latest retry, once the draft it replaces is closed or merged.
AnswerRetry(w) ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ Holding(w)
        /\ RetryActive
        /\ pred # "draft"
        /\ retryPosts' = retryPosts + 1
        /\ UNCHANGED <<posts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed, codePushed, prs, pr,
                       merges, pred, intent, inRun>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<watchPosts, marked>>
        /\ UNCHANGED EffectVars
       )

\* Answer the latest build with its pull request.
PostBuild(w) ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ Holding(w)
        /\ BuildActive
        /\ runs["build"] = "done"
        /\ codePushed
        /\ prs >= 1
        /\ buildPosts' = buildPosts + 1
        /\ UNCHANGED <<posts, retryPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed, codePushed, prs, pr,
                       merges, pred, intent, inRun>>
        /\ UNCHANGED <<watchPosts, marked>>
        /\ UNCHANGED EffectVars
       )

\* Answer a writer's retry that watches the latest build's failed draft
\* again: the factory watches it, and says what follows once CI's gate passes.
AnswerWatch(w) ==
    /\ lane = "ordinary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lane, fence, follow>>
    /\ (
        /\ Holding(w)
        /\ WatchActive
        /\ watchPosts' = watchPosts + 1
        /\ UNCHANGED <<posts, retryPosts, buildPosts, runs, runStarts, ratPushed, codePushed, prs,
                       pr, merges, pred, intent, inRun, marked>>
